thesis: MORNING (11:00 ET) read on Tuesday 2026-08-18: what changed at the open. Structure-first, and the multi-month frame is intact: SPY 769.2 carries a deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, Double bottom pattern-qualified), +2.72% over its 50-day (~748.8) and +9.39% over its 200-day (~703.2), mom126/252 +13.43%/+20.59%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.12 (roughly 1% under the highs). SPMO 151.51 holds its 50-day (+0.67%, ~150.5, maStack tangled) with mom21 +5.3 and +16.38% over its 200-day (~130.2); QQQ 719.74 and XLK 186.08 hold their 50-days. But the open did NOT reclaim: today gapped down -0.52% and reads a Range day under Mixed control (intraday-tape-lab VWAP 768.65, spot 768.29, 14 bars), sitting AT the 768 put wall and BELOW the 773.07 flip in negative dealer gamma. options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (asOf 2026-08-18T10:18:08Z) read SPY in NEGATIVE dealer gamma, signed net GEX -3.54B, flip 773.07 with the spot wedged between the 768 put wall and the 773 call wall, front expected move plus-or-minus 4.2, atmIV 14.76%, playbook range-break-watch / conviction patient, so around the flip dealers amplify rather than dampen (though GEX, atmIV and the expected move are all less extreme than the pre-market window). Participation did not broaden: market-heatmap-lab reads breadth 26.1% of 134 (narrow, margin -33.9), and counting by distinct market-bar dates (60.25% on 8/10, 56.47% on 8/11, 49.85% on 8/12, 65.06% on 8/13, 51.05% on 8/14, 26.1% on 8/17 and 26.1% on today's bar) the 8/13 reclaim was a one-bar spike, so three-bar persistence above 60% is not established. Flow, however, has NORMALIZED: options-flow-feed-lab is now balanced (callFraction 0.4356, call premium $435.2M against put premium $563.8M across 12 tickers, 737 contracts clearing the $250k bar), the pre-market $209M SPY 775-put crescendo has cleared; the largest prints are a QQQ 719 PUT ($21.8M, 0DTE) and a SPY 768 PUT ($20M, 0DTE, right at the put wall), with an AMD 480 PUT ($3.3M on 5.1x open interest, 1DTE) the most unusual. Leadership stays risk-on: sector-research-lab reads Rotate toward XLK as XLI weakens, and XLK carries the highest sector rsMom (101.71) and is Improving (quad I, accel +1.93, +18.19% over its 200-day), funded from weakening XLF (rsMom 98.85, quad W) and XLI (rsMom 99.2, quad W, accel -0.7) while XLV/XLE lead (quad L), XLY/XLRE lag (quad A) and XLU/XLB/XLC improve; etf-momentum-lab ranks VGT first (31.85%, 13 funds scored, SPMO 28.69); global-rotation-lab keeps EWS Singapore first (89.8 vs ACWI, EWT Taiwan and EWC Canada next); real-assets-lab keeps copper CPER the outright lead (60.2) with BTC 42.2, GLD 40.2 and SLV 18.8 below, an industrial-metals tilt with no dominant precious-metal haven (GLD 403.24 tangled, -2.26% under its 200-day). bond-regime-lab cannot make the credit or duration call, an independent credit-spread reading is not available in this view yet, but its high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio reads strengthening through 8/17 on both aligned pairs, a mild risk-on tell with the curve positive. company-fundamentals-lab (MSFT) returns only a stale pre-print foundation (statement 2026-03-31) with no direction available in this view yet; ai-capex-strategy-lab is a dated 2026-06-30 scenario-assumptions estimate, not measured returns; technical-analysis-decision-lab published only its data foundation and its owner five-gate model does not feed the brief yet; fx-regime-relative-value-lab withheld every currency family for lack of an approved source, so it is not applicable this window; causal-rotation-lab flags selective credit transmission as a watch only, not plan-eligible and still needing confirmation; and msft-july-print-model, smart-money-flow-lab, strategy-self-improvement-lab, strategy-validation-lab, trend-dynamics-cycle-lab, waterfront-polo-lab, palm-springs-rental-market-lab, ocean-shores-rental-market-lab, portfolio-survival-allocation-lab and research-agenda-lab made no call this cycle. PLAN for the rest of today 2026-08-18, structure-first: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core, the 20>50>200 bull-stack is intact and SPMO holds its 50-day with mom21 positive. HOLD the FIRST measured beta-add tranche and keep the remaining tranches PAUSED, breadth is 26.1% and the open did not broaden; with dealers still in negative gamma at the put wall this is no place to add, release the rest only when a completed close re-reclaims and holds breadth above 60% while SPMO holds above ~150.5 and SPY reclaims the 773.07 flip. ROTATE toward XLK (highest sector rsMom, Improving, rotating in) funded from weakening XLF/XLI, keeping XLY/XLRE OUT. HOLD MSFT (480.67, maStack still tangled, mom5 -5.02 now negative, mom252 -7.27 still negative) and do NOT chase; confirm the repair on daily CLOSES holding above the 200-day (~431.0). On the hedge: dealers stay negative around the 773.07 flip with SPY at the 768 put wall, but the put crescendo has cleared and flow is balanced with the expected move compressed to plus-or-minus 4.2, so carry a MODEST tail into the rest of today, and add to it only if SPY closes below the 768 put wall into deeper negative gamma; retire it on a close that reclaims the 773.07 flip back into positive gamma with VIX under ~14.5. Open risk into the rest of today: no scheduled high-importance release today, the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28, and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items.
